providers.title: AI Providers
providers.description: OpenAI-compatible APIs your model profiles can use. API keys are kept in the system keychain and never shown again.
providers.name: Name
providers.baseURLDescription: The API root, usually ending in /v1.
providers.baseURLKeyWarning: Changing the base URL removes the saved API key.
providers.baseURLInvalid: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
providers.apiKeyDescription: Optional for local servers. Saved in the system keychain.
providers.apiKeySaved: Saved in the system keychain; it can't be shown.
providers.addModelsDescription: Choose the models model profiles can use.
providers.removeConfirm: Remove {count} provider(s)? Their saved API keys are deleted, and profiles using them need another provider.
providers.notFound: This provider doesn't exist any more.
providers.noEnabledModels: No models enabled yet: add some from the provider's list.
providers.removeModelsConfirm: Remove {count} model(s) from this provider? Profiles using them keep their choice until edited.

models.title: Model Profiles
models.description: A model profile is a provider's model with a system prompt. Features use one of them.
models.cannotRemoveDefault: The default profile can't be removed. Choose another default in Features first.
models.name: Name
models.noModels: This provider has no models yet: add some in Providers.
models.modelMissing: {model} is no longer enabled on this provider.
models.systemPromptDescription: Sent with every request that uses this profile.
models.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a helpful writing assistant.
models.toolsDescription: Lets chats search and read your notes, and propose edits.
models.toolsInfo: Edits are proposed to the open note. Turn off for models without tool calling.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Sent with this profile's chat replies and editor assistant requests.
params.info: Not with chat titles. Off leaves a parameter to the provider. Providers ignore what they don't support: Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API has no top K, min P or repetition penalty.
params.temperatureDescription: Randomness: lower is more focused and repeatable, higher more varied.
params.topPDescription: Picks from the most likely words whose probabilities add up to this.
params.topKDescription: Picks from only this many of the most likely words.
params.minPDescription: Leaves out words less likely than this share of the likeliest one's probability.
params.frequencyPenaltyDescription: Positive values make words already used often less likely.
params.presencePenaltyDescription: Positive values make any word already used less likely, nudging new topics.
params.repetitionPenaltyDescription: Above 1 discourages repeating text; 1 is off.
params.maxOutputTokensDescription: The longest a reply can be, in tokens.
params.seedDescription: The same seed with the same request gives the same reply, where the provider supports it.
params.stopDescription: The reply ends where one of these would appear.
params.extraDescription: A JSON object sent with each request as it is, for provider-specific options.
params.extraInfo: Fields the request already sets are kept.
params.extraInvalid: Not a JSON object; not saved.

models.removeConfirm: Remove {count} model profile(s)? Features and chats that use them switch to the default profile.
models.notFound: This model profile doesn't exist any more.

features.defaultProfileDescription: Used by every feature that doesn't choose its own.
features.sectionDescription: Which features are on, and the model profile each uses.
features.sectionInfo: A workspace's choices apply only when its folder is trusted.
features.untrusted: This workspace's AI feature choices don't apply until you trust it.
features.enabledDescription: Off turns off the editor assistant, chat and chat titles.
features.enabledInfo: Your chats stay where they are.

ai.off: AI is off, so nothing here is used.
